ValidationRule.description:
The Shipping and Billing address must be completed before submitting for approval
BOPI-581 ByPass added to skip validations when syncing quote with account changes
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(ApprovalStatus__c), OR( ISBLANK(SBQQ__Account__r.ShippingCountry), ISBLANK(SBQQ__Account__r.ShippingPostalCode), ISBLANK(SBQQ__Account__r.ShippingState), ISBLANK(SBQQ__Account__r.ShippingStreet), ISBLANK(SBQQ__Account__r.BillingCity), ISBLANK(SBQQ__Account__r.BillingCountry), ISBLANK(SBQQ__Account__r.BillingPostalCode), ISBLANK(SBQQ__Account__r.BillingState), ISBLANK(SBQQ__Account__r.BillingStreet) ) ) && Quote_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please complete the full Billing and Shipping Addresses on the Account record
